decisions.reason: The source changes USBLC6 U3 wiring for USB data-line ESD protection; it does not change the separate MT3608 5V boost rail, its enable control, loads, or interboard routing.
The source concerns D+/D- routing and supply-pin wiring on the USBLC6 protection device, not the LED daughterboard's LED part, supply voltage, data interface, or connector assignments.
